notes: Single source of truth for the bounded DSV4 PP8 resident production envelope. Materialized topology/runtime/KV JSON files must match this file. This profile is the first-three DSV4 parallelism step after live Qwen+Gemma+DSV4 startup and warm-cache COMPSEC runs showed stable steady-state RAM headroom. It raises DSV4 to 64 active short-context sequences and 32768 batched tokens while using the smallest deployed fixed KV allocation above the observed 1.92GiB requirement for the declared 262144 max model length startup contract: 2GiB resident/offload KV per rank. Long-context cohorts are still admitted by token budget rather than by sequence count alone. It keeps DSV4 JIT KV prefetch exposure fixed and rebalances layers to 4/5/4/7/5/5/7/6 so spark2/spark4/spark5 recover host RAM and spark0 keeps API margin. It preserves a 768MiB preallocated vLLM workspace required before workspace locking, 0.18 GPU utilization, SM121 DeepGEMM warmup skip, indexed sparse MLA prefill, the SM12x rowwise decode kernel for up to 64 rows, eager decode while DSV4 batch correctness is requalified, IPv4 socket DSV4 PP sampled-token NCCL broadcasts over ds4ring0, and the DSV4-only warmup requirement before all-three residency.
